# Opening — Unicode and punctuation

This fixture preserves curly “quotation marks”, apostrophes in words such as it’s, an em dash —, an en dash – and an ellipsis… without rewriting the text.

It also includes Latin characters used in ordinary publishing: café, naïve, façade and £12.50.
